mapper.sql: id, dist_order_id, category, action, from_status, to_status, seller_id, seller_name, account_id, amount, settle_status, after_sales_status, operator_type, operator_id, remark, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_erp_distribution_order_log (dist_order_id, category, action, from_status, to_status, seller_id, seller_name, account_id, amount, settle_status, after_sales_status, operator_type, operator_id, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{distOrderId}, #{category}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{sellerId}, #{sellerName}, #{accountId}, #{amount}, #{settleStatus}, #{afterSalesStatus}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorId}, #{remark}, #{createTime}NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_erp_distribution_order_log WHERE dist_order_id = #{distOrderId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE l FROM t_erp_distribution_order_log l LEFT JOIN t_erp_distribution_order o ON o.id = l.dist_order_id WHERE l.create_time < #{cutoff} AND o.id IS NULL LIMIT 5000
